data.title: Faraday Future Launches U.S. Robotics Program as FCC Adds Foreign Robots
data.description: FF EAI Robotics reached 394 units toward a 2,000-unit full-year target; initial implementation of three of four cores is complete, with a partner conference planned soon.
data.author: Stock Titan
